important_documents.summary: Today’s through-line is straightforward: the Council is converting an EU-level legal commitment into deployable money. Two Council Implementing Decisions—[1] for France and [2] for Czechia—both dated 10 April 2026, “make available” financial assistance under the same overarching framework, Regulation (EU) 2025/1106.
